stories.title: No. 3 Utah stays perfect, snaps losing streak to No. 9 BYU
stories.summary: Devon Dampier accounted for all four Utah touchdowns and the defense picked off Bear Bachmeier four times as the No. 3 Utes beat BYU 28-20 to stay unbeaten and end a three-game rivalry skid.

stories.title: Evan Vickers, Mike Schultz to lead Utah’s Legislature after tumultuous midterms
stories.summary: After a bruising midterm cycle, Republican caucuses tapped Sen. Evan Vickers of southern Utah as the next Senate president and Mike Schultz to lead the House; Luz Escamilla returns as Senate minority leader.

stories.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
stories.summary: Security firm Apiiro reports finding credentials exposed in 1,122 public GitHub files linked to coding agents' saved "Don't Ask Again" permissions — a good prompt to check what agent settings files you commit.

stories.title: ‘It’s not over today’: Real Salt Lake completes an amazing run to reach the MLS playoffs
stories.summary: A 2-1 Decision Day win over the LA Galaxy, plus help from other results, sent Real Salt Lake into the MLS playoffs as the West's final seed — and knocked the Galaxy out.

stories.title: 34-year-old man shot and killed in Salt Lake City’s Granary District
stories.summary: A 34-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday in Salt Lake City's Granary District; police are looking for a suspect who drove off southbound.

stories.title: Shelter-in-place lifted in Salt Lake after police take barricaded suspect into custody
stories.summary: A 12-hour shelter-in-place near 900 South and 1900 East ended after a man accused of making threats and firing shots inside a home was taken into custody.

stories.title: Utah's only third-party lawmaker trails in bid for full term
stories.summary: Sen. Emily Buss of Eagle Mountain, the Legislature's only third-party member, trails Republican Brooks Benson roughly 49% to 51% in the Senate District 11 count.

stories.title: Lake Powell rises more than 21 feet since historic low in mid-September
stories.summary: Lake Powell has climbed more than 21 feet since its record low in mid-September, one of the strongest late-season recoveries in years.

stories.title: Utah sees big improvement with latest drought map
stories.summary: Weeks of heavy rain and flooding have sharply improved Utah's drought picture — and even revived the usually dry Gunlock Falls in southwestern Utah.

stories.title: Quiet weather continues across Utah, with haze building next week
stories.summary: Expect a dry, quiet stretch with gradually warming temperatures through next week, though valley haze is likely to build.

stories.title: Sugar House liquor store project paused over neighborhood concerns
stories.summary: The state has paused a planned Sugar House liquor store after neighbors raised traffic concerns and its proximity to a recovery center.

stories.title: Utah suburb eyes ban on chain-link fences to preserve its beauty ‘years, decades, centuries’ down the line
stories.summary: West Valley City is weighing a ban on new chain-link fences in front yards as a long-term beautification move.

stories.title: Secret drug lab discovered in crawl space of Saratoga Springs home
stories.summary: Five people were arrested after investigators found a hidden lab in the crawl space of a Saratoga Springs townhome, allegedly used to make synthetic cathinones.

stories.title: Utah Royals stun the San Diego Wave in NWSL playoffs
stories.summary: In the first NWSL playoff game in club history, the Utah Royals upset the San Diego Wave 1-0.

stories.title: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
stories.summary: A post on hunch.net about Microsoft Research winding down its AI Frontiers group sparked a big discussion about the state of corporate research labs.

stories.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
stories.summary: A look inside Apple Intelligence's on-device personal knowledge graph, including an undocumented classifier that labels which contacts are family.

stories.title: Alpine Linux : openssh-server password authentication bypass
stories.summary: Alpine Linux disclosed a password-authentication bypass in its openssh-server package — patch any Alpine-based images that run sshd.

stories.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
stories.summary: A new METR report on Anthropic using its own models to accelerate AI development, with models reportedly improving about twice as fast as a year ago, is unsettling some researchers.

stories.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
stories.summary: Reporting suggests at least one Chinese firm cleared to receive Nvidia H200 chips listed an empty office, raising questions about Commerce Department and Nvidia vetting.

stories.title: What I run on my $10 USD OpenStick homelab
stories.summary: A tour of what one person runs on a $10 OpenStick — a cheap LTE dongle repurposed as a tiny Linux server.

stories.title: Running a law firm on Free software
stories.summary: A UK tech law firm's 2026 update on running the whole practice on free and open-source software.

stories.title: Asahi Linux Progress Linux 7.3
stories.summary: The Asahi Linux team's progress report for Linux 7.3 on Apple Silicon Macs.

stories.title: Workflow dependency lockfiles
stories.summary: GitHub documents workflow dependency lockfiles for Actions, a way to pin the actions your workflows pull in.

stories.title: Good riddance, Cybertruck!
stories.summary: Elon Musk says Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production next year to make room for the Cybercab.

stories.title: A new Go API for JSON
stories.summary: Go 1.27 ships encoding/json/v2 and encoding/json/jsontext as stable packages; the Go team walks through the new API and migration.

stories.title: Django security releases issued: 6.1.3, 6.0.10, and 5.2.19
stories.summary: Django 6.1.3, 6.0.10 and 5.2.19 fix six CVEs, three of them in GeoDjango — upgrade soon.

stories.title: Two Dimensional Version Control
stories.summary: Red Blob Games writes up its experience moving to Jujutsu (jj) and how it changes the way you think about version control.

stories.title: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file
stories.summary: Simon Willison's rule of thumb for confusing dependency errors since moving to Python 3.15: when in doubt, delete uv.lock and re-resolve.

stories.title: llm 0.37
stories.summary: A big release of the llm CLI and Python library, rolling up about two months of features and fixes plus new model support.

stories.title: datasette-agent 0.5a0
stories.summary: Datasette Agent adds a "panel" that keeps the agent chat docked beside Datasette pages as you browse.
